sentences.text: Perusal of the record would reveal that the notice was issued to the complainant/informant and as per the report of the Incharge, Chief Judicial Magistrate, Balrampur dated 31.03.2022, the same has been served.
However, no one has appeared on behalf of the opposite party no.2.
Perusal of the record would further reveal that a co-ordinate Bench of this Court had earlier directed to list this case after all witnesses of fact are examined in the trial court.
The said order was passed on 02.06.2022.

However, thereafter despite communication of the said order to the trial court, no prosecution witnesses were examined by the trial court and in this scenario this Court vide order dated 02.01.2023 had again directed the trial court to record the statement of the witnesses of fact immediately and a copy of that order was also transmitted to the trial court for compliance and it is shown that the compliance report is still awaited.

However, learned counsel for the applicant Kadir has drawn the attention of this Court towards the rejoinder affidavit and submits that till now not a single witness has been testified before the trial court.
It is in this scenario, this Court is proceeding to finally adjudicate the prayer of bail of the aforesaid applicants.

Learned counsels for the accused-applicants while pressing the bail application submits that the applicants have been falsely implicated in this case and they have not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

It is further submitted that the allegations as have been levelled by the informant in the first information report and in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. are patently false and could not be believed.

In this regard, the attention of this Court has been drawn towards the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she had categorically stated to have accompanied the applicant Kadir on her own and have also stated to have solemnized marriage with him and also that she was pregnant by two and half months from applicant Kadir.
However, her father had administered some medicine by which the fetus was aborted.

Various allegations have also been levelled by the prosecutrix against her father in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. to the tune that her father is instrumental in lodging false cases against the applicant Kadir and his family members and on 07.02.2021, she had herself fled away from the house of her parents by jumping from the window and, thereafter, had gone with applicant Kadir and remained with him at Ahmedabad and Poona, as his wife.

It is vehemently submitted that the story, as cooked up by the informant in the first information report lodged by her has been negated and denied by the prosecutrix and she was a consenting party and since she had solemnized marriage with the applicant Kadir, the allegations, as levelled by the informant in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. as well as in the first information report are patently false, absurd and could not be believed.

It is also submitted that, though the date of birth of the prosecutrix as per her educational credentials is shown to be 18.03.2004, but her age has been determined as 20 years through Kadir vs State Of U.P. No offence as in fact has been committed by the applicants.

It is further submitted that applicant Kadir is in jail in this case since 05.04.2021, while applicant Usman is in jail in this case since 23.11.2021 and despite opportunities given to the trial court not a single witness has been testified so far and having regard to the pendency of the criminal cases before the trial court, it is not expected that the trial of the instant case may be concluded in near future.

The applicant Usman is not having any criminal history while against applicant Kadir one case was lodged by the father of the prosecutrix, wherein the applicant Kadir has been granted bail by the learned trial court vide order dated 08.12.2020 passed in Bail Application No. 48 of 2020.
There is no apprehension that after being released on bail they may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that the manner in which the offence is shown to have been committed with the prosecutrix, the applicants are not entitled to be released on bail, moreso,
in the background that the applicant Kadir is also having criminal history of one case which was lodged by none other than the father of the prosecutrix.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that despite opportunities provided to the trial court for recording of the evidence of the prosecution witnesses, not a single prosecution witness has been testified till now.
The matter of personal liberty of an under trial or even of a convict is to be taken on priority and the same could not be left at the mercy of the prosecution.

The first information report of the instant case was lodged by the mother of the prosecutrix levelling certain allegations against the accused persons named therein pertaining to the kidnapping of the prosecutrix and also pressurizing her to do compromise in the earlier case instituted against the instant applicant Kadir by the father of the prosecutrix pertaining to enticing away the prosecutrix by Kadir and commission of rape.
The prosecutrix was recovered with the applicant and it is alleged that on seeing the police party the applicant Kadir had fled away.

It is mentioned in the recovery memo prepared by the police, that the prosecutrix was found with the applicant Kadir and she had covered her face with a 'scarf' and in this background, it is submitted that the conduct of the prosecutrix is sufficient to demonstrate that she was a consenting party.

The statement of the prosecutrix was also recorded by the doctor at the time of medical examination wherein she has not imputed any allegation against the applicant and has stated to have accompanied the applicant Kadir on her own free wish and will.

The statement of the prosecutrix was also recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she apart from exonerating the applicant Kadir and other accused person had levelled certain allegations against her own father pertaining to lodging of false cases against the applicant Kadir.

However, after recording of the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 Cr.P.C. the investigating officer had recorded the additional statement of the prosecutrix under Section 161 Cr.P.C., even in that statement, the prosecutrix has not alleged anything pertaining to the rape committed on her but had stated that she could not know what had happened after when she had departed from her house.

sentences.text: Applicant Kadir and Usman are in jail in this case since 05.04.2021 and 23.11.2021, respectively.

Apart from Kadir against whom one criminal case was lodged by the father of the prosecutrix, the accused persons are not having criminal history to their credit and the presence of the applicants may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

In the considered opinion of this Court, having regard to all the facts and circumstances especially the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. before the Magistrate, the facility of bail may be extended to the applicants.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicants have made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicants- Kadir and Usman involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall not attempt to make contact with the prosecutrix either directly or indirectly or through any social platform or with any of the prosecution witnesses and the violation of this condition alone shall be a sufficient ground for the trial court to cancel the facility of bail granted by this Court.
(ii) The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(iii) The applicants shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iv) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
